description: For a natural number \(n>1\), the equality-language theory asserting exactly \(n\) elements has no universal axiomatization.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.exact_size_not_universal (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.HasUniversalAxiomatization
      {FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.cardGe FirstOrder.Language.empty n ⊓
          FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not (FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.cardGe FirstOrder.Language.empty (n + 1))}
